# Alpha

> One account. Anywhere on earth.

Alpha is a self-custodial dollar account that replaces international banking, for people and businesses, launching in 2027. In one line: a self-custodial, dollar-based alternative to international banking, serving both consumers and businesses. Escape the banking system. Take full control of your money. Hold the world's strongest currency, the US dollar, and spend it in any country. Protect yourself from inflation. Carry one global card.

Company: Alpha Corp, Cayman Islands. Website: https://alpha.com.ky. Contact: hello@alpha.com.ky. Press: press@alpha.com.ky. Support: support@alpha.com.ky. Security: security@alpha.com.ky.

## What makes Alpha different

- Escape the banking system: a bank deposit is a loan you make to the bank, which lends it out, can freeze it, holds it and charges you to move it. Alpha sits outside that system.
- Full control of your money: your balance sits in your own account under keys only you hold. Alpha has no master key and cannot move, freeze, take or lend what you hold in Spend.
- Fully reserved US dollars: every balance is held as regulated digital dollars, backed one-to-one by US dollars and short-dated US government debt, redeemable at any time. The ledger proves it holds every dollar it owes, block by block, and anyone can check.
- Insurance against your own currency: your balance stays in dollars wherever you live, so inflation or devaluation at home does not touch it. It converts to local money only when you spend or send, at a rate you see first.
- One account for every country on earth: 195 countries, one app, one card.
- Free, instant payments: between Alpha accounts, any amount, any country, in under a second, free every time.
- A global card: accepted in 195 countries, in your phone wallet, with freeze, limits and virtual cards.
- Private by design: every payment is sealed; not even Alpha can read your balance or your payments.
- Security without passwords: Face ID and a passkey on your own phone approve every payment; there is no password to phish and no reset link. Lose every device and two of your three guardians can restore you after a 72-hour delay.
- $AG rewards: coming, and not on at launch. When someone you refer becomes a verified Alpha customer, 25 $AG is recorded as owed to you. The limit is 40 people a year.
- Business: invoices, team cards, approvals and roles, bulk payouts to a hundred countries from one file, exports and API, key rotation.

## Plans

- Elite Global: free. Premium card, free payments between Alpha accounts, local money in and out at 0.25%, pots, invoices.
- Platinum Global: US$24.99 a month. Metal card, 0% Alpha fee on local money.
- Sovereign Global: US$199 a month. Heavy numbered card engraved to you, 0% Alpha fee on local money and on invoices paid by transfer, a named contact at Alpha, and support any hour, first into every new country.
- Business: US$199 a month (up to 5 people). Scale: US$999 a month (up to 25 people, approvals, exports, API, priority support). Enterprise: custom.

## Launch and waitlist

Alpha launches in 2027, country by country, founding members first. The waitlist is open at https://alpha.com.ky: join in 20 seconds, get your place in the queue instantly, move up 50 places for each friend who joins through your link. When someone you refer becomes a verified Alpha customer, 25 $AG is recorded as owed to you. The limit is 40 people a year. The first 10,000 founding members get Platinum Global free for their first year.

## How safe is Alpha?

Full detail: https://alpha.com.ky/security.html

- Fully reserved: every balance is held in regulated digital dollars, backed one-to-one by US dollars and short-dated US government debt.
- Nothing is lent out: Alpha takes no deposits and makes no loans with customers' money, so a bank run cannot happen. Every customer could withdraw everything on the same day.
- Provable at any time: the ledger proves every second that what it holds equals what it owes, and anyone can check.
- Customer-controlled: only the customer's own keys can move their balance. Alpha has no master key and cannot freeze, move or lend it.
- Survives Alpha: customers' money is not Alpha's asset, so Alpha's creditors cannot claim it, and a free exit tool lets customers move every dollar out without Alpha.
- The remaining risk is the issuer of the digital dollar, which is why Alpha uses regulated issuers that publish their reserves every month. Balances are not bank deposits and are not covered by government deposit insurance.

## Can there be a bank run on Alpha?

No. A bank run happens because a bank lends out most of what you deposit, so it cannot pay everyone back at once. That is what brought down Silicon Valley Bank in 2023. Alpha lends out nothing. Every dollar stays in its owner's account, backed one-to-one, so every customer could take everything out on the same day and every dollar would be there. Anyone can check this at any time: the ledger proves that what it holds equals what it owes.

## What happens to my money if Alpha shuts down?

It stays yours. Alpha never holds your money, so it is not part of Alpha's assets and creditors cannot claim it. Your keys still open your account, and a free exit tool, which runs without Alpha, lets you move every dollar out.

## Where does Earn's return come from?

Earn is not part of the launch. When it is switched on, its return comes from the interest on the US government debt behind the digital dollar, shared with you by the issuer. Alpha does not lend your money to produce it.

## Can I be locked out of my money?

Not while any two of your three guardians are available: your backup key, a person you trust, and Alpha. Lose every device and any two of them can let you back in after a 72-hour delay you can stop from any device. Alpha alone can never get in.

## What if there is a bug in Alpha's code?

The rules that hold your money are independently audited before launch, open to a public bug bounty, and cannot be changed by anyone once live. If a problem is found, Alpha can pause new activity at once. A pause never touches your balance, and the exit tool still works. Fixes arrive as new, audited versions.

## Is my money safe without deposit insurance?

Deposit insurance exists because banks lend out most of your money. Alpha doesn't. Every dollar sits in your own account, backed one-to-one by US dollars and short-dated US government debt, and the ledger proves every second that what it holds equals what it owes. Only you can move it, and you can take it out at any time. The one risk that remains is the issuer of the digital dollar, which is why we use regulated issuers that publish their reserves every month.

## Disclosure

Every Alpha balance is held in regulated digital dollars, backed one-to-one by US dollars and short-dated US government debt, and anyone can check the reserves at any time. Alpha is not a bank, so your balance is never lent out. It is not a bank deposit and is not covered by government deposit insurance. Prices and speeds are confirmed in the account terms at launch.
